el.Canciones que nacen de abrazar las sombr: Songs born from embracing the shadows, accepting life and turning pain into art and medicine. Singing circles, ceremonies and gatherings to come back to the body and the voice.
“Fly, my daughter, I want you to be happy.” A song born from a deep journey through nature, beauty and wonder.

el.No se trata de «aprender a cantar», sino: It's not about “learning to sing,” but about remembering a natural ability that was silenced by shame, fear and pressure to perform. Mantras, shamanic chants, percussion and group dynamics to reconnect with the body, the elements and the community.
Singing regulates, brings order, releases and unites. A space to set sound free, breathe and inhabit your voice with freedom.
el.Volver al Templo de la Diosa: elementos,: Returning to the Temple of the Goddess: elements, song, dance, art and ritual to awaken the gifts that live within us.
el.Formación en Círculos de Canto para faci: Training in Singing Circles for facilitators, therapists, yoga teachers, musicians and anyone who feels the calling. Includes a workbook of dynamics and songs.
el.«En mi vida hay tres grandes viajes que: “Three great journeys guide my life: music, plants and community.”
el.Abrió el show de Onda Vaga en el Teatro: She opened the Onda Vaga show at the Teatro Margarita Xirgu, with live percussion and guitar. Ceremonies, festivals and circles in Argentina and Barcelona.
